entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker hunter from the dead plane of Skalla, held captive in Luneau by the Baron of Vernot, who wants her Arkbow.

entities.name: Baron of Vernot
entities.description: A pale, affected nobleman and vampire-like scientist of Luneau who tortures Vivien to learn the secrets of the Arkbow and vivisects a monstrosaur.

entities.name: King Lucard
entities.description: The king of Luneau, who sits with courtiers watching the baron's vivisection and Vivien's confrontation.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker who destroyed Skalla; Vivien recalls him rising into a burning sky.

entities.name: The Arkbow
entities.description: A bow made by the shamans of Skalla for Vivien that, at a creature's death, draws the dying creature's image into itself and can conjure it back; it kills the baron's captors and assistants.

entities.name: Skalla
entities.description: Vivien's home plane, razed to ashes by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Luneau
entities.description: The opulent city ruled by King Lucard, with a criminal underbelly of corridors beneath it, where the baron holds Vivien.

entities.name: Monstrosaur
entities.description: A dinosaur displayed in a show days earlier, now being kept alive and hobbled while the baron vivisects it.

entities.name: The Nuns
entities.description: Nuns in nacreous robes with mouths sewn with gold thread who heal Vivien after torture, dress her and repair the monstrosaur during the vivisection.

events.summary: Vivien wakes, bloodied and suspended in manacles, as the Baron of Vernot tells her he has taken her Arkbow.
The baron describes his failed attempts to use the Arkbow and questions what Vivien is, speculating she is a Planeswalker.
events.quote: I wonder if you are a Planeswalker.

events.summary: Vivien demands the Arkbow back; the baron refuses and presses her on how it works, and she mentions Skalla.
The baron tortures Vivien repeatedly with boiling-blood magic and blades, and nuns heal her each time; Vivien resists, having already been scarred by Bolas's destruction of Skalla.
events.quote: Each time he asked his questions, the baron's magic reached out, found the blood coursing through Vivien's body, and brought it to boil.

events.summary: The nuns bathe Vivien, dress her in a penitent's gown, chain her and lead her through the underground corridors toward the baron's luxurious quarters.
events.quote: But she said nothing, silent as the nuns laced her wrists with filigree chains

events.summary: Vivien is locked in a lavish cell with a table of fruit, trapped again.
Left alone, Vivien relives the death of Skalla and Nicol Bolas rising into the burning sky, even in her dreams.
events.quote: When Vivien slumbered, she dreamed Skalla.

events.summary: A guard fetches Vivien, saying the baron has something to ask her, and she accepts rather than endure more stillness.
events.quote: Death, at that moment, appealed more than the continued ennui.

events.summary: Vivien is brought to a ballroom where the baron vivisects a living monstrosaur before King Lucard and his courtiers.
events.quote: He was, Vivien realized with a dazed start, not performing an autopsy, but a vivisection.

events.summary: The baron reveals he has deduced Skalla is dead and Vivien is its last living relic, and offers her glories and a queen's place if she teaches him to use the Arkbow.
events.quote: Teach me how to make use of the weapon and we will garland you with glories, ensure that you are never with an unfulfilled desire.

events.summary: Vivien feigns capitulation, agreeing to show the baron the Arkbow's mechanism but insisting she needs the weapon and that only she can perform the ritual.
events.quote: You can try all you want, but it won't work unless I'm performing the ritual.

events.summary: Vivien needles the baron until his composure cracks, declares she does not fear him but he fears her, and signals King Lucard, whose lady-in-waiting begins to bring a drink.
events.quote: But I think I scare you.

relations.note: He holds and tortures her as his captive.
relations.quote: Allies, as opposed to torturer and victim.
the sight of Nicol Bolas rising into that burning sky, laughing as Skalla winked to white

relations.note: Made by the shamans of Skalla specifically for Vivien's hand.
relations.quote: It was made for use by the shamans of Skalla.
